title: On a running test install with no open items and free builder slots, master status shows the empty-board alarm
description: Starts a real temporary Postgres control plane with no open items and four free builder slots idle for over 15 minutes; one loop cycle raises the empty-board stallAlarm, wakes the Lead, and master status heads with the empty-board alarm naming the free slots.

steps.name: running test install with no open items and free builder slots shows the empty-board alarm in master status
